description: fetch_public_key() in inbound.rs fetches the public key from the keyId URL embedded in the inbound Signature header. A Mastodon-compatible attacker can set keyId to their own server, host a crafted public key, and sign any activity with the corresponding private key. The signature verifies, the actor_url is derived as keyId.split('#').next(), so the attacker impersonates any actor. This is a fundamental SSRF-assisted authentication bypass. The fetched key must be validated against the expected actor's document, or the keyId domain must be validated against a trust anchor.
title: HTTP sig: pub key fetched from keyId URL controlled by attacker
